summary: LoRa/(G)FSK sub-GHz transceiver, 150-960 MHz, up to +22 dBm; SPI slave (mode 0, up to 16 MHz) plus BUSY, DIO1 IRQ and NRESET lines; 32 MHz crystal with internal trim caps (no load caps) or TCXO on XTA; 1.8-3.7 V. Entry wires the LDO regulation option (no DC-DC inductor). The RF front end (PA feed, match and harmonic filter, RX balun, RF switch on DIO2) is not on this part: it lives in the subcircuit sx1262-frontend-915, so the bare die is not offered as a radio.
